paragraphs: Desk tape (16 Oct 2026): The gas limit is the trade — the full Monad mainnet blotter, keywords and contracts linked, including the NADXBT fill of +0.02078 MON, the UNCLE fill of +0.01414 MON, a direct AFF hop of +0.000367 MON, and a Pancake v3 AUSD round trip of +0.001729 MON, all after gas. A wider pass found no new quote above the gas limit. The closest gross was +0.021119 MON. A follow-up requoted that cross at +0.017491 MON and sent nothing. The next set of quoters peaked at +0.019962 MON and sent nothing. Training corpus: json, jsonl. Hourly public read of block, base fee, and the shMON…
